series.title: SCP — Semicha Chaburah Program
series.subtitle: Yoreh Deah with Rabbi Leibtag
series.description: Shiurim covering Yoreh Deah — beginning with Siman 75 (Nat Bar Nat) and continuing through Siman 123 (yayin nesech). Building on the previous zman's coverage of basar b'chalav.

shiurim.title: Introduction to Nat Bar Nat
shiurim.hebrewTitle: נותן טעם בר נותן טעם — מבוא
shiurim.description: Opening shiur of the zman. Reviews basar b'chalav fundamentals (hana'ah, achilah, bishul), introduces nat bar nat (נותן טעם בר נותן טעם), surveys the Gemara in Chullin (דגים שעלו בקערה), Tosafos in Zevachim, and a three-way machlokes Rishonim: Rivan/Rashi, Sefer HaTerumah/Rosh, and Rambam. Covers Shulchan Aruch Siman 95, seifim 1–2, and the Rema's chumra. Concludes with practical shailos on ice cream (Dayan Weiss / Minchas Yitzchak) and the pareve cake question.

jokes.text: On yayin nesech: "If you drink wines other than just Moscato it will affect you. So in my house we'll be alright, but maybe your house you'll have to figure this out."
On his son's kashrut shayla about an onion cut with a fleishig knife: "So I told him he'd better call somebody else."
On impressing Roshei Yeshiva in shiur interviews: "You have to speed through [בפני נכתב ובפני נחתם] so you know it sounds like you know what you're talking about."
On drinking coffee with a pareve cake after a fleishig Shabbos meal: "Not real coffee — we're talking about milchig coffee here with cream. Like normal people."

disgracefulFoods.context: The only wine apparently served in Rabbi Leibtag's house — and apparently the only wine above yayin nesech concerns
"Not real coffee" — real coffee requires cream, apparently
